description: Single-Spark AnyTop job: BVH clips of one rig in, new 20 fps motions of that rig out. AnyTop takes no text prompt: it generates from a skeleton's topology and joint names alone, trained on the Truebones ZOO animals and humanoids. A rig it has never seen is introduced the way the creator's README describes: the job runs the creator's skeleton preprocessing on your clips (four face joints orient the rig; an optional rest pose gives its natural rest rotations) and then samples the creator's pretrained unified model for it. There is no fine-tuning, and the creator's maintainers report weak results far outside the training distribution (quadrupeds, issue 24). The output is one motions.zip with a BVH per repetition, in the creator's normalised space (bones scaled to its average length, facing +Z, on the ground). The creator renders an mp4 stick figure for every clip and motion; this recipe skips that, and rewrites each BVH frame time to the true 1/20 s, which the creator's save leaves at 1/24 s. The checkpoint and its data files are research-only and non-commercial (derived from the Truebones ZOO dataset); the code is MIT. Recorded for information, never gated.

face-joint-left-hip.description: Name of the rig's left hip (or equivalent) joint. Creator default LLeg1.
face-joint-left-hip.label: Left hip joint

face-joint-left-shoulder.description: Name of the rig's left shoulder (or equivalent) joint. Creator default LArm1.
face-joint-left-shoulder.label: Left shoulder joint

face-joint-right-hip.description: Name of the rig's right hip (or equivalent) joint; orients the rig. Creator default RLeg1.
face-joint-right-hip.label: Right hip joint

face-joint-right-shoulder.description: Name of the rig's right shoulder (or equivalent) joint. Creator default RArm1.
face-joint-right-shoulder.label: Right shoulder joint

motion-length-seconds.description: Length of each generated motion; the creator allows up to 9.8 seconds.
motion-length-seconds.label: Motion length

num-repetitions.description: How many motions to sample, one per repetition.
num-repetitions.label: Motions

seed.description: Random seed of the sampling; the creator's default is 10.
seed.label: Seed
